blurbs: I couldn't find any host in Koblenz so I went to Boppard where I met a very lovely family. We went hiking together and had dinner and breakfast together. Everything was amazing.

When I started riding in the morning, I still had no idea where I'd be staying at night. I couldn't find any host in Bonn. On the next day I was going to go to Köln and then have a rest day there. As I also hadn't found anyone in Köln, that meant paying for 3 nights. So I went straight to Köln and paid just for 2. The scenary was so beautiful on the way! I met a few kind people who refilled my water bottle or helped me carry my heavy bike upstairs or gave me free pommes :D I feel like people are much kinder when you give them an opportunity of it.
